clips.title: The story
paras: Blackwolf River runs from Cragpool Lake through Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. The Venture Company's logging and industrial work has fouled its waters.

Blackwolf River runs through Windshear Crag, fed by Cragpool Lake. Venture Company loggers cut the surrounding woods with heavy machinery and buzzsaws. Sludge, oil, and logging waste drain into the current. The river carries the cost of the company's work through the basin.
